family: The single total family fixed in proof.md: Li's sumset extractor. f_n := SumsetExt_n, the explicit extractor family of X. Li (FOCS 2023; full version arXiv:2303.06802v2, Theorem 7.13 with Definition 1.1 there for uniform polynomial-time computability), taken at error 1/8: a uniformly polynomial-time computable family at every input length n, an extractor for the sum (bitwise XOR) of two independent (n,k)-sources with min-entropy k >= c*log2 n. The fixed polynomial-time evaluator is the uniform algorithm of Theorem LI; the language is L = {x : f_|x|(x) = 1}, in P, with empty NP witnesses.
theorem: For this one fixed total uniform polynomial-time family, hence one NP language with empty witnesses, at actual input length n=|x| in the full Li-Yang B2 model: liminf C_B2(f_n)/n >= 114062441973/25000000000 = 4.56249767892, by the complete McGuire-Schlesinger-Williams wire-graph/cutwidth route reproduced in proof.md with the rule-bound constant kappa_E = (3/(2*pi))*arccos((1+2*sqrt(2))/4) certified in checks.py.
